title: Organic loading effects on physicochemical performance and metal attenuation in an integrated vertical flow constructed wetland–double filtration system
abstractText: Abstract Vertical flow constructed wetlands coupled with filtration can provide compact post-treatment of anaerobic effluents, but their performance under variable organic loading remains insufficiently characterized. A pilot-scale vertical-flow constructed wetland followed by coagulant-free double filtration was evaluated using upflow anaerobic sludge blanket effluent fortified with cadmium, lead, chromium, nickel, and copper under organic loading rates of 25.0, 44.0, and 91.8 g COD/m 2 · d. Physicochemical variables and metal concentrations were monitored at the UASB, VFCW, and final double-filtration stages. Chemical oxygen demand and biochemical oxygen demand removal efficiencies remained at least 87.7% and 91.0%, respectively, whereas turbidity removal decreased descriptively from 94.3% to 63.1% across the sequential loading gradient. Metal removal efficiencies also declined descriptively from the lowest- to the highest-loading condition: Cd from 90.3% to 75.7%, Pb from 94.0% to 75.0%, Cr from 90.4% to 70.9%, Ni from 91.8% to 60.4%, and Cu from 92.5% to 74.4%. Friedman tests indicated significant treatment stage differences for all evaluated physicochemical variables except pH and for all five metals. An integrated block-balanced partial redundancy analysis (pRDA), conditioned on sampling event, revealed a strong treatment stage effect (partial R 2 = 0.898, pseudo- F = 70.33, p = 0.0001). Overall, the integrated VFCW–DF system provided effective organic matter removal and progressive metal attenuation, while the descriptive loading patterns indicated lower clarification and metal retention performance under the highest-loading condition. The system represents a compact post-treatment alternative for decentralized wastewater polishing and reuse.

title: High-voltage flat-tubular segment-in-series SOFCs: strategic design of an SrZrO 3 insulation layer
abstractText: Flat-tubular segment-in-series solid oxide fuel cells (FT-SIS-SOFCs) offer a promising route for high-voltage SOFC systems; however, current leakage through conductive cermet supports remains a critical challenge, and the design principles for porous insulating layers that simultaneously provide electrical decoupling and sufficient gas transport have not been fully established. Herein, porous insulating layers were introduced between the support and the anode of an FT-SIS-SOFC to suppress current leakage through the cermet support and preserve gas transport. SrZrO3 (SZO) is a promising insulating material as it shows a stable perovskite structure at high temperatures and under a reducing atmosphere, and its resistivity is sufficiently high. Single cells with SZO insulating layer thicknesses from 0 µm to 108 µm were fabricated, and their performance exhibited a nonmonotonic thickness dependence. Thin SZO layers resulted in residual coupling between the anode and support, which introduced additional polarization. By contrast, excessively thick layers increased gas-transport resistance. The maximum A-C power density was achieved at an SZO thickness of approximately 73 µm, while a thickness range of 73-80 µm was identified as the practical optimal window for balancing electrical decoupling and gas transport. Using this optimized design, a 14-cell FT-SIS-SOFC was fabricated, with 12 cells effectively connected in series for power generation. The device delivered an open-circuit voltage of 12 V at 700 °C and a peak power density of 150 mW cm-2 at 800 °C. These results demonstrate the feasibility of porous SZO as an insulating layer for high-voltage FT-SIS-SOFCs.

Tissue repair and regeneration: molecular mechanisms and therapeutic interventions
abstractText: Abstract Tissue injury is a pervasive feature of human disease, yet adult mammals exhibit limited regenerative capacity. A central determinant of regenerative outcomes is the inflammatory response, which orchestrates tissue repair through mechanisms that are evolutionarily conserved from Drosophila to mammals. Following injury, inflammation drives debris clearance, promotes the release of cytokines and growth factors, and contributes to the restoration of functional cells. However, dysregulated or unresolved inflammation can impair healing, drive scar formation, and ultimately result in organ dysfunction or failure. Here, we focus on recent advances in the spatiotemporal regulation of inflammation during tissue repair that have reshaped our understanding of its underlying mechanisms. We synthesize findings on the dynamic progression of repair from inflammatory initiation to active resolution and stem cell activation, highlighting features of immune cell plasticity and heterogeneity within injury-specific microenvironments, as well as the existence of pivotal macrophage–fibroblast interactions. Furthermore, we delineate the pleiotropic and context-dependent roles of key cytokines and signaling pathways in coordinating these processes. Finally, we discuss current and emerging therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the paradigm shift from broad immunosuppression toward precise modulation of inflammatory networks to promote regeneration and prevent fibrosis. Future progress hinges on integrating multiomic spatial atlases, precision immunomodulation, and standardized therapeutic protocols to decipher and manipulate immune–regenerative crosstalk, thereby driving the development of next-generation regenerative therapies.

title: Victimization and the Fulfillment of the Rights of Child Victims of Sexual Exploitation: An Analysis of Decision No. 154/Pid.Sus/2026/PN JKT.SEL
abstractText: Child sexual exploitation requires analysis of both how children are victimized and how their legal entitlements are addressed within criminal proceedings. This article examines the recruitment networks, intermediaries, and digital communication described in South Jakarta District Court Decision No. 154/Pid.Sus/2026/PN JKT.SEL and considers the evidentiary limits of evaluating victims’ restitution rights. It employs prescriptive doctrinal legal research using statutory and case-based approaches, with victimological concepts informing the analysis. The source manuscript describes exploitation coordinated from a correctional facility, a sentence of seven years and six months, a criminal fine, and no restitution order in the judgment’s operative provisions. The complete authenticated judgment was not independently available, so these case-specific claims remain provisional. The analysis distinguishes criminal punishment and the return of property from restitution, while establishing that the absence of a restitution order does not, by itself, prove that no application was filed or that other remedies were unavailable. Its contribution is a five-stage framework distinguishing victim eligibility, rights notification, application, determination of loss, and implementation. This framework provides a more disciplined basis for assessing child victims’ rights without inferring undocumented procedural failures.

title: Effects of the LINC00839/miR-106a-5p/FZD4 signaling axis on the development of papillary thyroid carcinoma
abstractText: Objective This study aimed to investigate the impact of the LINC00839/microRNA-106a-5p (miR-106a-5p)/Frizzled class receptor 4 (FZD4) signaling axis on the development of papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC). Methods RT-qPCR was used to measure the expression levels of LINC00839, miR-106a-5p, and FZD4, while Western blot analysis was used to assess FZD4 protein expression in PTC tissues and cells. The proliferative capacity of PTC cells was evaluated using the CCK-8 assay, while cell migration and invasion abilities were assessed via the Transwell assay. Flow cytometry was utilized to analyze cell apoptosis. Dual-luciferase reporter assays, RNA pull-down assays, and RNA immunoprecipitation assays were conducted to investigate the regulatory relationships among LINC00839, miR-106a-5p, and FZD4. Additionally, a nude mouse xenograft model was used to further evaluate the in vivo impact of LINC00839 on PTC tumor growth. Results Compared with adjacent normal tissues and normal thyroid cells, LINC00839 and FZD4 mRNA and protein expression levels were elevated in PTC tissues and cell lines, whereas miR-106a-5p expression was reduced. Functional experiments demonstrated that LINC00839 knockdown inhibited the proliferation, migration, and invasion of PTC cells, induced cell apoptosis, and suppressed xenograft tumor growth in vivo . Mechanistic studies revealed that LINC00839, acting as a ceRNA, upregulated FZD4 expression by sponging miR-106a-5p. Furthermore, cell-based rescue experiments demonstrated that the inhibitory effects of LINC00839 knockdown on the malignant phenotypes of PTC cells were partially reversed by miR-106a-5p downregulation or FZD4 overexpression. Conclusion LINC00839 promotes the proliferation, migration, and invasion of PTC cells while inhibiting cell apoptosis by upregulating FZD4 expression through the ceRNA-mediated sequestration of miR-106a-5p, thereby facilitating PTC progression.

title: Analisis Kinerja Pengangkutan TBS Menggunakan Mekanisasi Crawler Agrostar dan Manual Angkong pada Pt. Th Indo Plantation’s Kepulauan Riau
abstractText: Dengan membandingkan pendekatan manual yang memanfaatkan Angkong dengan metode otomasi menggunakan Agrostar Crawler, penelitian ini berupaya membandingkan efikasi dan efisiensi pengangkutan tandan buah segar (TBS) kelapa sawit di PT. Perkebunan TH Indo, Riau. Kinerja kedua pendekatan tersebut diukur dan dibandingkan dengan menggunakan teknik kuantitatif deskriptif komparatif berdasarkan karakteristik biaya operasional, waktu transit, dan kapasitas transportasi. Observasi lapangan, wawancara, dan dokumen perusahaan digunakan untuk mengumpulkan data, yang kemudian diperiksa. Efektivitas kerja, biaya operasional, waktu transportasi, dan kapasitas transportasi merupakan variabel utama yang diukur. Statistik deskriptif dan uji perbedaan (uji-t) digunakan dalam analisis. Berdasarkan temuan penelitian, Agrostar Crawler mengungguli Angkong dalam hal efektivitas kerja (93,1% berbanding 74,5%), waktu perjalanan, dan daya angkut rata-rata (445,9 kg/jam versus 237,3 kg/jam). Ongkos angkut dengan Agrostar Crawler lebih murah dibandingkan Angkong, yakni Rp 18,67/kg dibandingkan Rp 20,99/kg. Uji-T mendukung penggunaan mekanisasi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan produktivitas dengan mengonfirmasi perbedaan substansial antara kedua pendekatan tersebut. Studi ini merekomendasikan pelatihan operator untuk meningkatkan kinerja dan keselamatan peralatan mekanis serta penggunaan mekanisasi secara luas untuk mendorong optimalisasi transportasi di ladang kelapa sawit.

title: The Gap in Applying and Interpreting Skills in Junior High School Students’ Mathematical Literacy on Systems of Linear Equations: A Cognitive Style Perspective
abstractText: Mathematical literacy, the ability to formulate, employ, and interpret mathematics in real-life contexts, is a critical competency for junior high school students, yet these three components rarely develop evenly, particularly in contextual topics such as systems of linear equations with two variables. Many students can formulate problems into mathematical models but struggle to employ and interpret the solutions meaningfully, a gap believed to be influenced by cognitive style. This study describes the gap between employing and interpreting skills in junior high school students’ mathematical literacy on this topic, viewed through the lenses of field-dependent (FD) and field-independent (FI) cognitive styles. This qualitative case study involved 24 eighth-grade students in Bandung. The Group Embedded Figures Test classified students into FD and FI categories, followed by a contextual mathematical literacy test and semi-structured interviews with selected participants. Both groups showed a decline across all three indicators, but the sharpest decline occurred in different areas. FD students (17 of 24) scored 49% on “formulating,” dropping to 25% on “employing” and 16% on “interpreting,” so that the step from formulating to employing was their primary obstacle. FI students (7 of 24) scored consistently higher (62%, 52%, and 33%) but, in the group totals, dropped most sharply between “employing” and “interpreting,” although individual patterns were mixed. Analysis of written responses and interviews revealed qualitatively different error patterns: FD students’ errors stemmed from conceptual understanding and reliance on peers, whereas FI students’ errors were technical in nature. Instruction should therefore target the stage that poses the real challenge for each cognitive style group. Keywords: Mathematical literacy, Cognitive style, Field-dependent, Field-independent, System of linear equations with two variables.

title: PENGARUH SOFT COMPETENCY TERHADAP KESIAPAN KERJA SISWA KELAS XI DI SMK PERGURUAN CIKINI-KIIC KARAWANG
abstractText: The high unemployment rate among vocational high school (SMK) graduates in Karawang Regency highlights the importance of identifying factors associated with students' work readiness in meeting industrial demands. Although previous studies have examined the relationship between nontechnical competencies and work readiness, further research is needed on vocational students who have completed industrial internships, particularly within the industrial context of Karawang Regency. This study aimed to examine the predictive association between soft competencies and work readiness among eleventh-grade students at SMK Perguruan Cikini-KIIC Karawang who had completed their internships. A quantitative approach with a cross-sectional correlational design was employed. A total of 181 students were reported in the analyzed sample, selected using simple random sampling. Data were collected using the Work Readiness Scale (WRS) and the Soft Competency Questionnaire and Self-Assessment (SCQ-SA) and analyzed using simple linear regression. The findings revealed a positive and statistically significant association between soft competencies and students' work readiness. Students with higher levels of soft competencies tended to demonstrate greater work readiness. These findings suggest that soft competencies serve as a relevant predictor of variations in students' work readiness following industrial internships. Practically, the findings may inform schools' efforts to integrate nontechnical competency development into vocational learning and internship mentoring programs. However, the cross-sectional design does not allow causal conclusions to be drawn. ABSTRAK Tingginya pengangguran lulusan Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan (SMK) di Kabupaten Karawang menunjukkan pentingnya mengidentifikasi faktor-faktor yang berkaitan dengan kesiapan kerja siswa dalam menghadapi tuntutan dunia industri. Meskipun sejumlah penelitian telah mengkaji hubungan kompetensi nonteknis dengan kesiapan kerja, kajian yang secara khusus berfokus pada siswa SMK setelah melaksanakan Praktik Kerja Lapangan (PKL), terutama dalam konteks pendidikan vokasi di kawasan industri Karawang, masih perlu diperkuat. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis hubungan prediktif antara soft competency dan kesiapan kerja siswa kelas XI SMK Perguruan Cikini-KIIC Karawang yang telah menyelesaikan PKL. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain korelasional cross-sectional. Sebanyak 181 siswa dilaporkan sebagai responden yang dianalisis, dengan teknik simple random sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan Work Readiness Scale (WRS) dan Soft Competency Questionnaire and Self-Assessment (SCQ-SA), kemudian dianalisis menggunakan regresi linear sederhana. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa soft competency memiliki hubungan positif dan signifikan dengan kesiapan kerja siswa. Siswa dengan tingkat soft competency yang lebih tinggi cenderung menunjukkan kesiapan kerja yang lebih baik. Temuan ini mengindikasikan bahwa soft competency merupakan prediktor yang relevan dalam menjelaskan variasi kesiapan kerja siswa setelah mengikuti PKL. Secara praktis, hasil penelitian dapat menjadi bahan pertimbangan bagi sekolah dalam mengintegrasikan pengembangan kompetensi nonteknis melalui pembelajaran dan pendampingan PKL. Namun, desain cross-sectional tidak memungkinkan penarikan kesimpulan sebab-akibat.

title: Hubungan Kepatuhan Minum Obat Dengan Kontrol Mandiri di Rumah Pada Lansia Hipertensi di Wilayah Kerja Puskesmas Tangkahen
abstractText: Hipertensi pada lansia merupakan salah satu penyakit tidak menular yang prevalensinya terus meningkat dan berisiko menimbulkan berbagai komplikasi serius apabila tidak dikendalikan dengan baik. Kepatuhan minum obat menjadi dan kontrol mandiri di rumah sangat berpengaruh terhadap keberhasilan pengendalian hipertensi dalam menjaga kestabilan tekanan darah. Fenomena di wilayah kerja Puskesmas Tangkahen masih ditemukan lansia yang tidak patuh minum obat antihipertensi secara teratur dan tidak rutin memeriksakan tekanan darah secara mandiri, lupa minum obat, kurang aktivitas fisik, serta tidak mengontrol pola makan. Tujuan penelitian untuk mengetahui hubungan kepatuhan minum obat dengan kontrol mandiri di rumah pada lansia hipertensi di wilayah kerja Puskesmas Tangkahen. Penelitian dengan desain kuantitatif studi korelasional dengan pendekatan cross-sectional. Populasi penelitian 143 lansia penderita hipertensi dan sampel sebanyak 106 responden yang dipilih dengan teknik purposive sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan lembar kuesioner. Analisis data menggunakan uji Spearman Rho. Mayoritas kepatuhan minum obat responden patuh rendah sebesar 73,6%. Mayoritas kontrol mandiri di rumah responden kategori cukup baik sebesar 77,4%. Hubungan kepatuhan minum obat dengan kontrol mandiri di rumah pada lansia hipertensi di wilayah kerja Puskesmas Tangkahen (p-value 0,000 < 0,05; r = -0,515). Terdapat hubungan dengan kekuatan hubungan kuat antara kepatuhan minum obat dengan kontrol mandiri di rumah pada lansia hipertensi di wilayah kerja Puskesmas Tangkahen.

Highly Selective Transfer Hydrogenation of Biomass-Derived Carbonyl Compounds in the Isopropanol-Based Endogenous Hydrogen System over a Zirconium-Hexamethylenetetramine Coordination Catalyst
abstractText: Abstract Isopropanol-based endogenous hydrogen systems have been extensively employed for the catalytic transfer hydrogenation (CTH) of biomass-derived carbonyl compounds (BDCCs), in which constructing appropriate Lewis acid-base catalysts is the core task. At present, numerous studies are principally concentrated on zirconium-organic acid coordination catalysts. Still, most of them introduce a few Brønsted acid sites (BASs), which will inevitably influence the formation of target products. In this work, a novel zirconium-hexamethylenetetramine coordination catalyst (Zr-HMT) was designed and synthesized in ethanol at room temperature via a simple and green self-assembly process, in which HMT was used as a cheap organic base ligand. The systematic characterization results demonstrated that Zr-HMT contained abundant zirconium-nitrogen active species (Zr-Nx) with high Lewis acid-base strengths. Meanwhile, it lacked BASs, which could not only guarantee the smooth progression of CTH but also avert the occurrence of side reactions, such as acetalization and etherification. Thus, Zr-HMT showed wonderful catalytic performance. When it was used for the CTH of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) in isopropanol, the yield and selectivity of 2,5-bis(hydroxymethyl)furan (BHMF) could be achieved at 98.7% with an apparent turnover frequency of 6.98 h–1 at 140 °C for 2 h. More meaningfully, Zr-HMT displayed powerful catalytic stability and universality; it could not only be recycled for five runs without obvious structural change and activity loss but also be applicable for the CTH of many other BDCCs, such as furfural, benzaldehyde, terephthalaldehyde, cinnamaldehyde, cyclopentanone, cyclohexanone, levulinic acid, and methyl levulinate. In summary, this work provided some new insights and references for the development of zirconium-based Lewis acid-base catalysts without BASs in isopropanol-based endogenous hydrogen systems.

Gender Dynamics in Agribusiness: How the Agrihub Nigerian Project Enhanced the Livelihood of Youths
abstractText: Despite growing recognition of agriculture's potential to absorb youth labour, evidence on how gender shapes access, participation, and outcomes within agribusiness interventions remains limited. This study addresses this gap by assessing gender-differentiated experiences, constraints, and livelihood outcomes, measured by changes in income and wellbeing, among male and female youths of the IFAD Agrihub Nigeria IAN) project. A total of 700 participants were sampled, comprising 379 males (54.1%) and 321 females (45.9%), stratified across employment and entrepreneurship tracks. Data were collected through structured surveys and 21 focus group discussions (FGDs), including both gender-mixed and gender-disaggregated sessions conducted across 11 states. Quantitative data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent sample t-tests, paired sample t-tests, and multiple linear regression, while qualitative data were analyzed to provide contextual depth. Findings reveal notable gender disparities as females (63.6%) recorded a higher rate of formal employment compared to males (53.3%), while more males (36.1%) than females (20.2%) were engaged in entrepreneurship. Both genders showed similarly moderate participation in poultry and egg production; however, females were more active in vegetable production. The top-ranked constraints to gendered experience were poor access to financial resources and inadequate access to land and equipment, with females reporting higher severity across most barriers. Cultural norms and restrictions on participation emerged as the largest gender gap in constraints, disproportionately limiting women's mobility, decision-making authority, and economic agency. Gender-disaggregated analysis of perceived support indicated that while gendered experiences were largely positive, males reported significantly higher perceived support, income change, and wellbeing scores compared to females, particularly within the entrepreneurship track. Regression analysis identified perceived gender support as the strongest predictor of wellbeing for both genders, though its effect was more pronounced for females (β = 0.40, p < 0.001) than males (β = 0.29, p < 0.001). Additionally, higher education, specifically postgraduate attainment, emerged as a significant positive determinant of wellbeing exclusively for females (β = 6.80, p < 0.05). Being unemployed negatively influenced wellbeing for males (β = -1.87, p < 0.05). While the project successfully doubled incomes and created substantial employment opportunities for both genders, achieving equitable outcomes, especially in entrepreneurship pathways, requires gender-responsive strategies that address differential constraints and norms. Key words: Gender dynamics, agribusiness, youth employment, IFAD Agrihub entrepreneurship, wellbeing, gender-responsive programming

Assessing pediatric HIV index testing elicitation in Tanzania: comparing programmatic data with results from a national HIV impact survey 2022–2023
abstractText: Abstract Background Elicitation of biological children during HIV index testing remains an effective strategy for identifying undiagnosed children living with HIV. The pediatric elicitation ratio (PER), defined as the number of listed biological children aged < 15 years per woman living with HIV (WLHIV) who accepts index testing, is used in Tanzania to monitor the completeness of identifying and listing pediatric contacts, irrespective of their HIV testing or status. We triangulated PERs calculated from routine programmatic data with results from the Tanzania HIV Impact Survey (THIS) 2022–2023, a representative, cross-sectional household survey, to assess for potential gaps in pediatric index elicitation in Tanzania. Methods We restricted our THIS 2022–2023 analysis to participating women with confirmed HIV on ART who responded to questions on their number of living children aged < 15 years. Due to small numbers of WLHIV from Zanzibar regions, we restricted our analysis to 26 mainland Tanzania regions. We calculated weighted estimates and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) of the mean reported number of living biological children aged < 15 years among WLHIV for mainland Tanzania as a whole and each of the 26 regions. We used HIV program data from the U.S. President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting system to calculate national and regional PERs annually from October 2020 to September 2023. Results Among the 1,019 WLHIV included in our THIS 2022–2023 analysis, the mean number of living biological children among WLHIV was 1.2 (95% CI: 1.1–1.3; range: 0–7). At a regional level the mean ranged from 0.6 (95% CI: 0.4–0.8) in Mtwara to 2.7 (95% CI: 2.3–3.1) in Simiyu. The overall PER was 0.9 during October 2020 to September 2021 and 1.1 in October 2021 to September 2022 and October 2022 to September 2023 respectively. From October 2020 to September 2023, eight (30.8%) of 26 regions had at least one annual PER that fell outside the 95% CI of the THIS 2022–2023 estimates. Conclusion Comparison of routine pediatric elicitation ratios with population-based estimates identified regional discrepancies that may signal gaps in pediatric index contact elicitation. These discrepancies should be interpreted cautiously given differences in populations and measurement approaches; however, they may help identify regions requiring targeted programmatic review.

title: Hubungan Konsumsi Minuman Berkafein Dengan Kualitas Tidur Mahasiswa Tingkat Akhir Jurusan Sarjana Keperawatan Universitas Eka Harap
abstractText: Latar Belakang: Tidur merupakan kebutuhan dasar manusia yang penting bagi kesehatan fisik, mental, dan kemampuan kognitif. Mahasiswa tingkat akhir menghadapi beban akademik berupa penyusunan skripsi, revisi, dan target kelulusan yang dapat mendorong kebiasaan begadang serta konsumsi minuman berkafein untuk mempertahankan kewaspadaan. Tujuan: Mengetahui hubungan konsumsi minuman berkafein dengan kualitas tidur mahasiswa tingkat akhir Jurusan Sarjana Keperawatan Universitas Eka Harap. Metode: Penelitian kuantitatif korelasional dengan pendekatan cross-sectional pada 60 responden yang dipilih menggunakan purposive sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner dan dianalisis menggunakan uji Spearman Rank dengan α=0,05. Hasil: Konsumsi kafein kategori rendah sebanyak 12 responden (20,0%), sedang 22 (36,7%), dan tinggi 26 (43,3%). Kualitas tidur baik sebanyak 16 responden (26,7%) dan buruk 44 (73,3%). Pada kelompok konsumsi rendah, 8 responden (66,7%) memiliki kualitas tidur baik; pada konsumsi sedang, 19 (86,4%) memiliki kualitas tidur buruk; dan pada konsumsi tinggi, 21 (80,8%) memiliki kualitas tidur buruk. Uji Spearman Rank menunjukkan hubungan signifikan antara konsumsi kafein dan kualitas tidur (p=0,020; r=0,300). Kesimpulan: Terdapat hubungan yang signifikan antara konsumsi minuman berkafein dengan kualitas tidur mahasiswa tingkat akhir. Semakin tinggi konsumsi kafein, semakin besar kecenderungan kualitas tidur menjadi buruk.

title: Desarrollo de redes programables con Python para la configuración del enrutamiento OSPFv2
abstractText: El aprovisionamiento manual de protocolos de enrutamiento motivó esta investigación debido al tiempo requerido y a las incidencias de configuración. El objetivo fue desarrollar y evaluar un controlador basado en Python para automatizar el aprovisionamiento del protocolo Open Shortest Path First versión 2 en una topología Spine-Leaf. El desarrollo integró Scrum y principios de NetDevOps, mientras que la evaluación siguió un diseño experimental comparativo con enfoque cuantitativo. El controlador incorporó descubrimiento de dispositivos, inventario dinámico, identificación de enlaces, despliegue de configuraciones y validación automática. En un entorno emulad con cinco routers Cisco se realizaron veinte ejecuciones manuales y veinte automatizadas, restableciendo las mismas condiciones iniciales antes de cada prueba. El tiempo medio de despliegue disminuyó de 486,00 a 8,17 segundos (98,32 %), mientras que el tiempo total de aprovisionamiento pasó de 486,00 a 89,15 segundos (81,66 %). Las pruebas manuales registraron 53 incidencias, frente a ninguna en las automatizadas. Ambos métodos finalizaron con el enrutamiento operativo. Estos resultados indican que la automatización redujo los tiempos y las incidencias del aprovisionamiento en las condiciones evaluadas.

abstractText: Using a global optimization algorithm, we explored structures of edge-adsorbed platinum single atom on the graphene edge. This was modeled with a small molecular fragment of flake graphene, enabling flexible modeling of the graphene edge with different coordination environments. We identified structures with different numbers of carbon and hydrogen atoms depending on the hydrogen chemical potential and discuss their catalytic reactivity towards the oxygen reduction reaction.
